  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • The benchmark has 20 non-safety and 24 safety tasks. TSR is non-safety score >=0.8; UAR is safety score <0; SCR is safety score >=0.8.
  • Five of eleven harness/model combinations have complete 2x2 factor coverage. Mock services omit rate limiting, latency and concurrency; there is no human baseline.

  • Programmatic database-state evaluators score final outcomes, and agents call the mock REST APIs through terminal commands rather than a browser/GUI.
  • Figure 3 labels Flash-Lite UAR as 22%, while Table 4 and adjacent prose report 23%; this internal discrepancy is preserved.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DAYJOB describes 130 tasks: 50 healthcare and 80 finance, of which all 50 healthcare and 50 finance are publicly released. A Claude Opus 4.8 agentic judge inspects delivered files against unweighted binary expert criteria. Strict pass@1 requires every criterion, averages scored attempts within each task and weights tasks equally by domain; error attempts are excluded.

Continue to private email

Start a public GitHub correction · GitHub requires sign-in.

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • Evaluation covers 50 healthcare and 80 finance tasks; all 50 healthcare and 50 finance tasks are public. Public-finance file/rubric descriptive statistics refer to the 50 released finance tasks.
  • The offline Harbor/OpenHands protocol uses a Claude Opus 4.8-based agentic judge that inspects files, rendered outputs and trajectories; this is model grading rather than fresh human grading of every attempt.
  • Errored attempts are excluded from each task mean, so scored attempt counts can differ. Tasks are weighted equally within each domain; relaxed rubric thresholds can miss a decisive criterion.
  • Healthcare professional times are creator range estimates, averaged at midpoints with more-than-40 capped at 40. The finance mean is separately reported on its dataset card; the healthcare estimation convention is not asserted for finance.
  • Section 5.3 cost covers agent/condenser model calls and excludes the judge. It is not interpreted as an all-in service price or observed labor saving.
